shots.transition_other: video start; logo fades up from a dimmed state on the gradient background
shots.typography: Geometric sans in title case; primary agent cards in a medium/semibold weight, task chips smaller regular weight, normal tracking; rounded-rectangle pill labels (font guess, low confidence: Avant Garde-style geometric sans)
shots.what_happens: On a deep purple gradient with a glowing horizon, the salesforce cloud logo brightens (0-1 s) and drifts left; a motion-blurred robot mascot flies in from the right across the frame (~2-2.5 s) and leaves tiny card sparks behind; the six primary agent cards pop/scale in (~3-3.5 s), then the smaller task chips sprout around each with connector lines until a complete agent mind-map fills the frame by ~5 s and holds while VO says w0-w10 ('Every company has more jobs to be done than resources available').
shots.build_rebuild: Over a radial purple gradient, scale-fade the logo in and translate it left, fly a blurred mascot sprite across with a motion-blur filter, then pop six primary cards with a 100 ms stagger followed by staggered task chips that draw short connector lines to their parent card.

shots.focal_element: the large 'Agentforce' wordmark with the 'What is Agentforce?' subtitle
shots.transition_other: vertical push: the agent mind-map slides up and out while the aurora/mountain title scene and wordmark rise in from below
shots.typography: Wordmark: very large, bold geometric sans in a soft lavender bevelled/extruded treatment with a script-like 'f'; subtitle: white bold geometric sans in sentence case, normal tracking, roughly a third of the wordmark size
shots.what_happens: The node map pushes up off the top of frame (6.5-7.5 s) revealing an illustrated aurora sky with stylised purple mountains; the 'Agentforce' wordmark rises from the bottom and settles centre (~8 s) with 'What is Agentforce?' beneath it, then the card holds with a gentle aurora shimmer while VO introduces Agentforce (w15-w22).
shots.build_rebuild: Push the previous scene up by 100% height while a layered illustration (aurora gradient, mountain silhouettes) and an extruded wordmark translate up from below with an ease-out, then fade the subtitle in under it and hold for ~3 s with a slow aurora opacity shimmer.
